name: Nostalgic 1999: Halloween Night
source:
The story picks up months after the events of Nostalgic 1999 when the girls are deciding what to go as for the scariest night of the year.

[From [url=https://phantom-gd.itch.io/nostalgic1999hn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事承接《追忆1999》事件结束数月之后，女孩们正商量着要在一年中最惊悚的万圣节之夜装扮成什么模样。

[摘自[url=https://phantom-gd.itch.io/nostalgic1999hn]itch.io[/url]]
